source_binding: Resolve this manifest at the selected commit and verify referenced blob identities.
coverage: Reviewed feature navigation and test candidates; not exhaustive semantic or runtime proof.

features.title: GitHub repository context and source lookup
invariants: Bind source ranges to the selected repository commit and blob.
Keep repository references, historical observations and personal documents distinct.
Graph edges and tests are candidates until verified.

features.title: Conversation privacy and AI profile selection
invariants: Saved private-chat authority follows its conversation and queued work independently of global availability.
Profile selection is distinct from dispatch authorization.
Protected display ranges require content-bound masking evidence.
Final outbound privacy receipts contain counts, revisions and request-keyed fingerprints, never originals or replacement maps.
Private plain-text replies restore incrementally; local tool control remains separately validated.
Diagnostic content defaults to redacted; full forensic consent and resume identity are separate.
Synthetic local checks report measured privacy, intent and timing scope without claiming cloud quality or accelerator execution.
Masked fallback publication revalidates captured provider and retained-source authority before each output; revoked authority preserves partial failure and never replays output.
Ordinary modal collisions require positive detector classification and exact request-local copied-span provenance; protected overlaps and all other known-value checks remain authoritative.

features.title: Voice playback, captions and speech benchmarks
invariants: Presented audio and reply identity own caption position.
Synthesis completion does not imply playback completion.
Physical acceleration and latency require device measurements.
Plan complete utterances within native bounds and distinguish current execution, profile availability and qualified comparisons.
Retain exact workload, voice, rate, source and thermal identity; playback measurements do not establish acoustic latency or battery benefits.
Keep native progress polling separate from synthesis-owned evidence and retain audio/model ownership until actual retirement.
Playback comparison requires the current controlled workload protocol, independent fixture coverage and observed provider execution.
Benchmark and Auto ranking require same-run CPU-reference duration, token timing and signal consistency; numeric consistency does not establish perceptual equivalence.
Retain at most two exact accelerator token shapes under observed memory headroom and a hard estimate ceiling; unknown memory retains only the active shape.

features.title: GitHub editing, task continuation and validation
invariants: Reconcile uncertain writes before replaying a mutation.
Publication requires current source and applicable verification.
Workers cannot grant controller or mutation authority.
Settle interrupted phone-index work only after exact local ownership and unwind evidence; preserve unrelated unknown remote operations.
Argument canonicalization is separate from semantic repair and its observed execution outcome.
A native saved-page read and proven provider delivery are separate facts; continuation retains original context, output and attempt limits.
Fixture mutation authority comes from the accepted task policy; general tool auto approval does not grant it.

features.title: GitHub model and context benchmark evidence
invariants: Freeze source, profile, task, budget and environment before comparison.
Hidden grader material never enters retrieval or model input.
Unknown cost, tokens and retrieval relevance remain unknown.

features.title: Gateway jobs, source mirror and development tools
invariants: The existing job owns source, execution, authority and publication.
Optional tool configuration never grants extra authority.
Exported source is not automatically model-admitted context.

features.title: Settled Markdown rendering and chat presentation
invariants: Keep privacy-sensitive content out of the shared parsed-document cache.
Retain current layout, font and theme inputs while reusing bounded settled parse results.
Device performance requires a measured device run.

features.title: Typed failure reports and diagnostic capture epochs
invariants: Keep diagnostic values within the shared closed vocabulary and exclude raw source/provider text.
Negotiate capabilities for newly introduced report fields while retaining compatible legacy payloads.
Do not combine observations across recording epochs or infer a historical crash cause without evidence.
